chunks.title: Stack Detection Engine
chunks.name: Sd1
chunks.description: Intelligent filesystem scanning to detect every language, framework, and project boundary in a repo. Magistr's existing `magistr detect` / `magistr init` (crates/magistr-core/src/detection) assume a single-stack project; real repos contain React inside .NET APIs, Cargo workspaces with Tauri GUIs, Python services beside Node backends. Extend the existing detection module (do not replace it) into a ProjectTree builder with parent/child hierarchy and relationship inference. Prior art (2026): Nx, moon, Turborepo and Bazel all model the repo as a project graph and infer per-project tooling — their workspace manifests are first-class topology signals.
acceptance: Define `StackMarker` enum — one variant per detectable marker file type (PackageJson, CargoToml, Csproj, GoMod, PyprojectToml, RequirementsTxt, Gemfile, ComposerJson, MixExs, PubspecYaml, DockerCompose, etc.) with associated metadata: file glob pattern, parse strategy, priority weight for specificity ordering

Treat monorepo-tool manifests as topology signals — nx.json / project.json (Nx), moon.yml, turbo.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, lerna.json, *.sln, Cargo workspace members — and read their project lists before falling back to directory walking

Implement `scan_directory()` — recursive filesystem walker that collects all marker files in a repo, respecting .gitignore and configurable ignore patterns (node_modules, target, bin/obj, __pycache__, .venv). Returns `Vec<(PathBuf, StackMarker)>` sorted by depth then specificity

Build framework-specific parsers — parse package.json dependencies to distinguish React/Next.js/Vue/Svelte/Angular/Express/Nest, parse Cargo.toml for workspace members and key dependencies (ratatui, actix, tauri), parse *.csproj for target framework and project type (web, console, lib), parse go.mod for module path and key imports

Define `DetectedProject` struct — path (relative to repo root), language, framework (Option), role (frontend/backend/library/cli/service/unknown), marker files found, parsed metadata (versions, dependencies). Define `ProjectTree` struct — root path, `Vec<DetectedProject>` with parent/child indices, workspace type enum (Cargo/Npm/Pnpm/Yarn/Lerna/Rush/Nx/DotnetSln/None)

Implement hierarchy inference — detect parent/child relationships between projects: SPA nested inside API (React in ASP.NET ClientApp/ or wwwroot/), workspace members (Cargo workspace, pnpm-workspace.yaml, lerna.json packages), docker-compose service directories, .sln file project references. Classify topology as: flat-monorepo, nested-fullstack, workspace, single-project

Implement relationship detection — infer inter-project dependencies: package.json workspace references, Cargo workspace path dependencies, .csproj ProjectReference elements, import/require statements referencing sibling projects, shared directory detection (e.g., shared/ or packages/common). Output as edges in the ProjectTree

Implement role classification heuristics — classify each DetectedProject role: frontend (has React/Vue/Svelte + no server framework), backend (has Express/ASP.NET/Actix/Django + no SPA framework), fullstack (has both), library (is workspace member with no binary target), CLI (has clap/commander/argparse), service (referenced in docker-compose). Use marker + dependency combination scoring

Extend the existing `magistr detect` CLI command — print the ProjectTree as a formatted tree view showing detected stack per node; keep the existing `--json` output backward compatible (single-project repos produce a one-node tree). Wire as a Tauri command for GUI usage

Build detection test suite — test against fixture directories representing common layouts: ASP.NET + React (nested ClientApp), Cargo workspace + Tauri GUI (this repo is one), pnpm monorepo (apps/web + apps/api + packages/shared), Python Django + React (sibling), standalone single-project, Go microservices with docker-compose, Nx workspace. Use tempdir-based fixtures with realistic marker files
